newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kaikai's B share offer priced at $0.26 per share.
newsitem.headline: Kaikai's B share offer priced at $0.26 per share.

text.p: Garment maker Shanghai Kaikai Industrial Co Ltd is set to launch an offer of 80 million foreign currency B shares priced at $0.26 each on Friday, an official involved in the issue said on Thursday.
That would give a P/E ratio of about seven times based on forecast per-share net for 1996, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter, China Securities Bulletin.

An underwriting agreement on the B share offer was held in Shanghai on Thursday, with the B share offer prospectus to be made public on Friday, said an official at Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co Ltd, lead domestic underwriter,
The B shares would be listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in early 1997, the official said.
Shenyin & Wanguo Financial (H.K.) Ltd was the international coordinator for the issue, he said.
Kaikai, which manufacturers shirts and woollen sweaters, aims to use the share proceeds to renovate production facilities and expand its sales network within China, the official said.
Kaikai has total share capital of 118 million shares, consisting of 71.74 million state shares, 31.26 million legal person shares and 15 million staff shares.
Shanghai-based Kaikai sells most of its Kaikai-brand shirts and sweaters in the domestic market, the official said.

Kaikai, whose net assets were valued at 200 million yuan, forecast post-tax profits of 60 million yuan for 1996, compared with 60.02 million yuan last year and 36.38 million yuan in 1994, under international accounting standards, the official said.
The earnings surge last year was due to its success in expanding sales, he said.
